scope: Known-source graph-assisted public-action consequence learning DEV by existing PublicCausalCells only; no native full Yggdrasil integration or prospectively unseen sources.
hypothesis: Mapping already known F42 graph components to the existing 7 active native causal-cell slots can share empirical public action/outcome evidence from one training QID with 71 other known-component QIDs; a same-information fully trained empirical component control should match native, and an identity-only memorizer should abstain. This is routing-enabled reuse, not learned graph structure or unfamiliar-world transfer.

native.training_events: For each of 7 components, present only its lowest numeric QID, 4 observed public experiences per action 0 and 1, 56 actual calls to native.observe, reveal outcomes only after action; no hidden QID evaluations during training.
native.post_train_interference: For each of 9 retained slots (retained=True), present 4 public observations per action with preferred action=(retained_slot_index+1)%2, 72 additional calls. Never overwrite active slots.
native.evaluation: Before and after interference, query all 71 other known-source graph entities without observing their public outcomes; route each to the same graph component learned during initial F42 source inspection; evaluate choosing action equal to component's frozen public-response law. Confirm exact checkpoint cold-restore predictions.
native.negative_controls: Wrong-component permutation slot+1 mod7 should not match all 71 evaluation labels; isolate 7 active and 9 retained addresses; single-arm-only/public outcomes unavailable abstains; corrupted checkpoint and F42 snapshot fail closed; neither unknown QID nor reserved QID admitted.
native.strong_controls: Fully trained conventional empirical 16-cell two-arm outcome-count table with exactly the same 128 public experiences, same 128 uint16 learned bytes and same F42 graph component routing must match native predictions; equal-info exact symbolic observed-action table must match. Raw-ID no-graph 7-node factual baseline, equally exposed to training QIDs/experiences, abstains on 71 different QIDs (not an equal-capacity native control).
native.budget: 128 total public observe calls (56 active, 72 retained), 71 heldout graph-node queries twice before/after interference, 7 active and 9 retained contextual states, no external requests, no training data or model calls.

classify: If native fails same-graph 71/71 accuracy, cold parity, retention or source scope: DEV_NATIVE_ROUTING_NO_GO. If native passes and equals strongest conventional, DEV_NATIVE_ROUTING_PARITY_ONLY. Native superior to conventional must be independently replicated; this test cannot yield SCIENTIFIC_PASS because world law and all QIDs/graph are already known and prospective source custody incomplete.
limitations: The seven component slots and all 82 graph edges are externally supplied: no learned relation discovery, source-first-use, identity generalization to unknown graph/components, causal-law discovery beyond observed reward counts, novel tokenless language representation, full Yggdrasil substrate or AGI. Engineering acceptance not science acceptance.
